_note: ENV-04 (E14): a test level, not a level to ship. A 3 m wide corridor the player sprints through, then the exit. Two crushing toy presses sit across the corridor on their own 4.32 s cycles, phase apart so they never slam the same step. The pad is square and short enough that the player can walk either side of it while the head is down, then cross the pad during the rest. Heights are clear of a standing player (who projects 1.8 m); the face comes down to 2 cm above the pad floor. Metres, Y up, -z is north, positions are box centres, sizes are full extents. Then the exit.
